correctness.rationale: For each fixed side pattern, the proof identifies the finite orbit problem with a translation action on an explicit binary matrix space. The action dimensions are 1, a, b, and a+b-1 for global complement, left switches, right switches, and two-sided switches, respectively; the formulas follow by orbit-space cardinality and summing over side assignments. Equality-pattern decomposition gives the Stirling transform. Exhaustive matrix-action checks on small rectangles and exact profile recomputation agree with every displayed formula.

originality.rationale: Targeted semantic searches before and after derivation, including exact formula/profile queries, found no matching published-finding corpus record. The closest literature classifies the reduct groups and gives switch/parity characterizations but does not state these orbit profiles or the all-arity collision between the left- and right-switch groups. Current general oligomorphic-group literature likewise does not supply the five formulas.

value.rationale: The result gives closed formulas, full-tuple Stirling transforms, and asymptotic growth for an entire finite reduct lattice. The identical profiles of two distinct closed subgroups provide a concrete limitation of tuple-orbit profiles as group invariants, while the formulas also quantitatively separate the remaining growth regimes.
